title: Assassin's Apprentice
author: Robin Hobb
summary: The unwanted illegitimate son of a prince is brought up in the royal stables and trained in secret as the crown's quiet killer. Looking back as an older man, he describes how raiders, court politics and a rare bond with animals shaped him.
readIf: you want a patient, emotional fantasy told in a first-person voice with a deep focus on character.
skipIf: you want fast action, since the first half is slow and the tone is often sad.

pairings.reason: Another confessional, first-person fantasy where a gifted outsider remembers how his story began.
A shorter, wiser coming-of-age fantasy with a similar quiet seriousness.
A much more cynical, violent fantasy for when you want to turn the mood harder and funnier.
